# Accuracy analysis: go-henri-gasc-cliphist-auto-generated-file

Measured 2026-10-13 on main 3f7c2b64 (`benchmark_optimal_solutions`, `painting_failure_census`,
`mismatch_detail_for_fixture`, `painting_disagreement_detail`). The engine changes; re-measure
before relying on these numbers.

## Numbers

| | |
|---|---|
| Mapping mismatches | 156 (102 visible) of 33506 nodes, 33506 graded, N:M floor 0 visible |
| Painting | none (fixture has no painting) |
| Ground-truth invariant violations | none |

## The change

A regenerated vendored file (`zsyscall_netbsd_arm.go`; `description.md`: "Auto-generated file").
Three wrapper functions change. `ioctlPtr` is inserted at after lines 408-414, `Setrlimit` is
deleted at before lines 1600-1606, and `mremapNetBSD` is inserted near the end. Each comes with
its own `// THIS FILE IS GENERATED BY THE COMMAND AT THE TOP; DO NOT EDIT` comment, which
separates every function in the file.

## Mapping

- Before lines 1600-1606 and after lines 408-414: 98 visible and 54 invisible mismatches. The ground
  truth deletes `Setrlimit` and inserts `ioctlPtr`. Omnidiff pairs the two functions as one moved
  and updated function. They are about 1200 lines apart and share only the generated skeleton: `_,
  _, e1 := ...(...)`, `if e1 != 0 { err = errnoErr(e1) }`, `return`. The name, the parameters and
  the syscall (`RawSyscall(SYS_SETRLIMIT, ...)` against `Syscall(SYS_IOCTL, ...)`) all differ. The
  printed reasons come from three passes. The `if e1 != 0 { err = errnoErr(e1) }` block (before
  lines 1602-1604, after lines 410-412) is paired by `GreedyAnchorBlock` and its inside by
  `APTED("greedy_anchor_block")` (24 visible, 18 invisible). This block is byte-identical
  boilerplate: it occurs 132 times in the before file and 133 times in the after file. The
  `function_declaration`, its body and its statement list are paired by `BottomUpPropagation` (6
  invisible, MatchButNotIdentical). The rest of the two functions is mapped by
  `APTED("fast_fallback")` (74 visible, 30 invisible): the name, the parameters and the syscall line
  as Updates (`Setrlimit` -> `ioctlPtr`, `RawSyscall` -> `Syscall`, `SYS_SETRLIMIT` -> `SYS_IOCTL`),
  plus `func`, `return` and the punctuation. I did not trace the order of these passes, so it is not
  established whether the boilerplate anchor or the fallback decided the function pair. `matcher`.
- Before lines 406, 1598, 1608 and after line 416: 4 visible mismatches on the repeated
  generated-file comment. The ground truth deletes the copy after `Setrlimit` (before line 1608)
  and inserts the copy after `ioctlPtr` (after line 416). Omnidiff maps before 1598 -> after 406
  (`APTED("fast_fallback")`), so the comment above `Setrlimit` travels with it to `ioctlPtr`. It
  also maps before 406 -> after 416 and before 1608 -> after 1608 (`LeadingSibling`). The copies
  are byte-identical, so which one is "new" cannot be told from the text, and omnidiff's choice
  follows from the function pairing above. `ambiguous`.

Reasons for the "with children" mismatches re-read on 2026-10-13 after the test helper began
printing them.

## Verdict

- Primary cause: `matcher`
- Other causes: `ambiguous`
- Where a fix would go: the passes that pair a deleted with an inserted `function_declaration`:
  `GreedyAnchorBlock` anchors one of 132 identical `if e1 != 0` blocks across 1200 lines, and
  `BottomUpPropagation` and `APTED("fast_fallback")` pair the enclosing functions (order not
  traced). Distant functions that share only generated boilerplate, with no name or call-target in
  common, should not be paired.
- Ground truth questionable: no
